name: Zhang Youxia
role: Former Chinese general and Central Military Commission vice chairman (2017–2026)
summary: Zhang publicly advocated Communist Party command, military modernisation and resistance to Taiwan independence. His international statements combined cooperative security language with threats of military force.

sources.title: 高质量推进国防和军队现代化 (High-quality modernization of national defense and the armed forces), 12 November 2025
sources.author: Zhang Youxia, People’s Daily; reproduced by The Paper/Sina

sources.title: 持续深化国防和军队改革 (Continue deepening national defence and military reform), 10 August 2024
